name: monacozen
description: an opinionated React wrapper around Monaco Editor

scripts.build: bun run vite build && build_lib out/intermediate --runtimeEntryFile src/main.js --outputFileName src/main.js --precompiled --copyFiles assets --terser-strength max --outputFolder ../../dist
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit --project test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/monaco-language-clank/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/monaco-language-logsql/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/monaco-language-metricsql/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/vite-plugin-add-monaco-languages/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/vite-plugin-lib-intermediate/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/vite-plugin-omit-monaco-languages/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/vite-plugin-override-monaco-themes/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project test-browser/tsconfig.json
